title: Podio Review (2026)
intro: Flexible work platform often used as a customizable CRM, with Free (5 users), Plus, and Premium plans. This review covers pricing posture, CRM capabilities, limitations, and fit based on first-party research — not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Podio overall score 6.1/10 from equal-weight CRM criteria. Free (5 users). Plus $11.20/$14, Premium $19.20/$24 annual/monthly per user.
verdict: Podio: Choose Podio when you want a flexible work platform you can shape into CRM processes. Scores reflect first-party research as of 2026-08-16 — not hands-on product testing.
